title: Knowledge Cards
tagline: Discover and learn new information through Knowledge Cards directly inside frames
description:
The project knowledge cards frame is developed for farcaster using open frames standard. This frame lets you search about a topic and discover information about it inside farcaster app itself.
A user can search any topic of the choice and the definition and synonyms of the test are displayed in the frame.
how_its_made:
We have leveraged frames.js framework to develop frames and open frame standard to make frames compatible with xmtp and farcaster app.
The app is developed using next.js and served through deployment on vercel platform. 
This was my first time working with frames.js and farcaster.
